verdict.rationale: A direct probe fetched https://posthog.com/openapi.json with HTTP 200, and the document contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and where to get it, and evidence of how much of the API it covers or how current it is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://posthog.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
